headline: Spelling fixes and new button wording on the home and pricing pages; safe to ship, with one small wording point to check.
what_changed: Fixed spelling on the home page: "patern" is now "pattern" and "attachements" is now "attachments".
Fixed spelling on the pricing page: "hobbiests" is now "hobbyists", and "14 day free trail" is now "14-day free trial".
The sign-up buttons on the home page and on every pricing plan now say "Start your free trial" instead of "Get started free". This goes beyond fixing typos.
Small wording tweaks: "scans" is now "scanned pages", and the Guild plan says "several locations" instead of "many locations".
The buttons still go to the same sign-up pages, so how people sign up has not changed.

risks.title: "Free trial" button on a plan that is already free
risks.explanation: The Starter plan costs $0, but its button now says "Start your free trial". A visitor may think the free plan ends or starts charging after the trial. This could cause some confusion or put off a few sign-ups, but it doesn't affect billing. Think about keeping "Get started free" on the Starter plan only.

questions_for_developer: Does the sign-up flow really start a 14-day trial for every plan, including the free Starter plan? The buttons now promise a "free trial".
Can the Starter plan's button keep saying "Get started free", since that plan never charges?
good_news: Only on-screen wording changed. Prices, plan features and sign-up links are exactly the same.
I found no other place in the project that relies on the old button text, so nothing else should break.
The spelling fixes make the pages look more professional to visitors.
